# GitUI capture provenance

Native GitUI 0.28.1 output, captured with TERM=xterm-256color and NO_COLOR unset
in a temporary demo Git repository at 98 columns × 32 rows. The staged recipe
diff and commit-message editor are real native screens; the message was typed
but no commit was submitted. These fixtures are replayed through Yoctui's
terminal emulator and typed PTY screen model, then the production renderer.
They demonstrate integration, not a live Yocto build or repository status.
